official_score_alternatives.authoritative_rule: The selected official formula, not an informal payload-plus-package subtotal, determines prize score.

official_execution.time_formula_hours: less than 70000 / T for each program, where T is the test machine Geekbench5 score
official_execution.main_page_summary: approximately 50 hours on a single CPU core
official_execution.resource_measurement_semantics: not numerically defined beyond the published wording

gamma_internal_objective.counting_policy: Count the selected official score formula and also retain an expanded closure total covering archive, required program and model material, dictionaries, tables, framing, command text, build files, runtime support, and every nonstandard dependency.
gamma_internal_objective.expanded_closure_is: a stricter internal reproducibility and economics gate, not a replacement for the official formula

selected official score formula with exact file accounting
official resource interpretation and compliant rerun
runtime normalization on an admissible machine
documented source and OSI license closure

committee_clarifications_required: Exact RAM unit and measurement boundary used during official verification
Whether peak process-tree resident memory, per-process peak, cgroup peak, or another measure is authoritative
How shared mappings and page cache are treated
